description: GCompris is open showing a category of activities that includes the Maze game. The Maze activity icon shows a penguin character inside a brown brick maze with a door exit. Click on the Maze activity to open it. Once inside, a penguin character appears in a maze and you must guide it to the door/exit using arrow keys (Up, Down, Left, Right). Navigate the penguin through the corridors to reach the door. Successfully completing the maze shows a congratulations animation with a lion appearing. Complete the maze (reach the door with the penguin).
